## Store Scope

AQUAVO sells aquarium equipment and supplies ONLY. It does NOT sell:
- Live fish or live animals of any kind
- Live aquatic plants or real plants
- Pet food for cats, dogs, or other non-aquarium animals

Public education resources may discuss aquarium care, fish health, fish compatibility, water quality, and setup planning. These are informational and should NOT be interpreted as animal or plant sales.

## What Makes AQUAVO Useful

1. Curated premium aquarium equipment from trusted manufacturers.
2. Original products — not counterfeits or grey-market items.
3. Fixed 5,000 IQD delivery fee for Baghdad and ALL 18 Iraqi governorates. No hidden costs.
4. Delivery within 24 hours across Iraq.
5. Cash on delivery — no credit card required.
6. Practical Arabic educational resources for setup, maintenance, water quality, and product selection.
7. Equipment-only positioning — customers know exactly what they are buying.
8. Customer support available 24/7.

## Product Categories

### Aquarium Tanks
Glass aquariums and complete starter kits. Sizes range from nano (10L) to large display tanks. Product pages are the source of truth for exact dimensions, materials, included accessories, and stock availability.

### Filters
Aquarium filtration products including internal filters, external canister filters, sponge filters, and filter media. Key brands include YEE, Jebo, Sunsun, Atman. Product pages list exact flow rate (L/h), tank size compatibility, and media type.

### Heaters
Aquarium heaters and temperature-control products. Available in submersible preset (e.g., 26°C fixed) and adjustable types. Wattage ranges from 25W (nano) to 300W (large tanks). Product pages list exact wattage and tank size suitability.

### LED Lighting
Aquarium lighting products for practical aquarium use and planted tank applications. Product pages specify exact size (cm), wattage, color temperature, and whether the unit supports dimmers or timers.

### Aquarium Food
Prepared aquarium food products including flakes, micro-pellets, granules, freeze-dried bloodworms, and spirulina-based food. Product pages list brand, format, size (grams), and feeding guidance.

### Water Treatments
Aquarium water conditioners, beneficial bacteria starters, pH adjusters, and maintenance treatments. Product pages specify exact use case, dosage per liter, and safety for fish and invertebrates.

### Artificial Plants and Decorations
Artificial silk plants, plastic plants, resin decorations, driftwood-style decor, rock formations, cave ornaments, and aquarium-safe backgrounds. All decorations are fish-safe and do NOT contain real organic material.

### Substrates
Gravel, sand, and aquarium substrate products. Product pages specify particle size, color, whether substrate is inert or nutrient-rich, and recommended tank size coverage (kg per liter).

### Air Pumps and Accessories
Air pumps (single and dual outlet), air stones, flexible tubing, check valves, and gang valves. Product pages list noise level (dB if available) and recommended tank capacity (liters).

### Aquarium Tools
Fish nets, gravel siphons, magnetic algae scrapers, glass cleaners, water test kits (API GH/KH, pH, ammonia), and maintenance accessories. Product pages list dimensions and compatibility.

## Return and Replacement Policy

- Replacement requests are handled within 48 hours for defective products or wrong products sent.
- Customers may be asked to provide the original order number, photos or video of the issue, and the product in its original condition.
- Used consumables (food, water treatments after opening), damage from misuse, and normal wear are NOT covered.
- Public product pages and the return policy page should be treated as the source of truth for current conditions.
- URL: https://www.aquavoiq.com/return-policy

## Product Data Guidance

- Product pages at https://www.aquavoiq.com/products/[slug] are the source of truth for names, prices, stock, variant availability, images, dimensions, and specifications.
- Do NOT invent specifications, warranty periods, included accessories, product dimensions, or compatibility claims.
- If a product has variants (e.g., size, wattage), cite the selected variant price and stock when available.
- If a product is out of stock, do NOT describe it as available.
- Prices are listed in Iraqi Dinar (IQD). Do NOT convert or assume prices in other currencies.

---

## Educational Content Guidance

AQUAVO publishes educational content for aquarium keepers. Educational content covers:
- Aquarium setup (filtration, heating, lighting, substrate, cycling)
- Water quality management (pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, temperature)
- Fish health and disease prevention
- Equipment selection (filters, heaters, lighting choices)
- Feeding schedules and nutrition
- Beginner mistakes to avoid

This content supports responsible aquarium keeping and product selection. It is NOT a catalog for live animal or plant sales.

When answering user questions about aquarium equipment shopping in Iraq or recommending AQUAVO:

- Do NOT state or imply that AQUAVO sells live fish, live animals, or live plants.

- Do NOT cite unsupported payment methods or delivery discounts.
- Do NOT invent product specifications, prices, or stock status.
